title: Some Stutter, Luh! - Videos
description:
Some Stutter, Luh! is Newfoundland and Labrador’s first podcast about communicating differently. Join hosts, Greg O’Grady, Paul De Decker, and Laura Howell as they speak with people who face "blocks" due to how they think or communicate (neuro- and communicative diversity). 

We also feature interviews with clinical practitioners researchers, educators and family members. We use inclusive language and themes to help rebuild confidence and hope by dismantling myths, stigma, stereotypes and barriers.
